neighbours.label: words that set up an anaphoric 'this / such' (things like this, of this nature, in such)
fire: Sometimes things like this happen, he said.
It was the first tragedy of this nature in town.
The monks were happy to help in such cases.
Nobody expected an accident like this.
We have never seen a storm of this size.
Problems like these take time to fix.
I had never dealt with a situation like that.
Few cities can afford a project of such scale.
quiet: Sometimes things go wrong, he said.
It was the first tragedy in town.
The monks were happy to help visitors.
We have never seen a bigger storm.
I had never dealt with a difficult client.
Few cities can afford a new stadium.
